description: One-factor-at-a-time PointGoal extension for trunk mass/inertia and low-level actor sensor noise using the frozen seed-42 model_1500 ONNX policy.

parameter_basis.mass_inertia: The training task scales trunk_base mass and inertia together by 0.95-1.05. This evaluation uses 0.90 and 1.10 as explicit 2x stress levels.
parameter_basis.imu_noise_low: Matches actor training uniform noise: base_ang_vel +/-0.03 rad/s and projected_gravity +/-0.01.
parameter_basis.imu_noise_high: Explicit 2x training-noise stress: base_ang_vel +/-0.06 rad/s and projected_gravity +/-0.02.
parameter_basis.joint_encoder_noise_low: Matches actor training uniform noise: joint_pos +/-0.001 rad and joint_vel +/-0.25 rad/s.
parameter_basis.joint_encoder_noise_high: Explicit 2x training-noise stress: joint_pos +/-0.002 rad and joint_vel +/-0.50 rad/s.
parameter_basis.scope_note: Noise is sampled independently at each 50 Hz control step and changes only low-level actor observation slices. Navigator pose and goal state remain simulator ground truth. Constant IMU mounting error and constant encoder bias are outside this protocol.

safety_gate.note: The 30-episode extension screen is diagnostic. Escalate a condition to 25 episodes only after a verified safety, success, tracking, or drift regression.

acceptance_gate.note: Full runs are selective escalation, not automatic follow-up for every condition. Evaluate each condition independently.
